# Plan only. No edits made.

## 1. Four replacement directions (05–08) and the 04 font

All four stay on the existing operator registry (`style-engines.ts`: `market`, `marea`, `riso`, `indice`) and the 2 GENERAL_PURPOSE / 2 ARTISTIC role split. Each gets a new home operator and new tokens, not a recolor of the old tiles. They are separated from each other and from 01–04 by hero structure, type, palette and how photos are cropped.

| # | Role | New world | Entry composition | Palette | Type |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 05 | General | **Casa y patio**: a warm Mediterranean dining room. Photo-first, an interior or table shot fills most of the first view. | Full-bleed hero with a docked, light "ficha" panel (name, tagline, Menú/Reservas). Under it, an uneven 3-up photo row of dishes and rooms. Then opinions, then direct links. | Cream, terracotta, olive-black, saffron accent | Young Serif (display) + DM Sans |
| 06 | General | **Cocina abierta**: a dark, calm evening restaurant. This is the opposite register to 05 and 01/02, both light. | 60/40 split. A tall portrait photo stack sits on one side, and a deep-green panel with large type and an inline hours/booking strip sits on the other. A rounded-corner (12–16px) photo mosaic follows below. | Deep green, charcoal, brass, ivory | Archivo (semi-expanded) + Newsreader for editorial text |
| 07 | Artistic | **Cartel duotono**: duotone photography on the admitted art assets. It replaces the huge yellow text poster. | Tall full-viewport duotone triptych (indigo/coral). The name is set modestly in a caption block over the photos, not as poster type. A staggered duotone gallery with short captions follows. | Indigo and coral duotone, off-white paper, near-black | Instrument Serif + DM Sans |
| 08 | Artistic | **Hoja de contactos**: a photo-led entry built as a contact sheet or film strip. | Opening grid of 8–12 grayscale frames of different sizes, with the name and links set into one cell. Grayscale → color is kept. It triggers on hover, on focus and on tap or scroll-into-view, so it never depends on hover alone. | Bone, ink, tomato red | Familjen Grotesk |

**04 font:** drop Bodoni Moda. Switch to **Fraunces** (soft optical axis): upright, weight 400–600, sentence case, no hairline italic, with the wine background and photography unchanged. Headings also get less extreme sizing, with a cap of about 6rem. The `em`/`i` styling stays upright wine, as it is now.

**Fonts for Codex to supply (self-hosted, with licences):** Fraunces, Young Serif, Archivo, Newsreader, Instrument Serif, Familjen Grotesk. DM Sans is already present. If any are missing, I will fall back to DM Sans plus an installed serif. I will not use a system display face.

## 2. Page-kind composition matrix

I will parameterize every interior by operator, not by customer. Each kind has one shared component with 2–3 composition variants selected by an engine attribute, and the CSS sits in one shared `interior-kinds.css` plus the per-engine tokens.

| Kind | Shared component | Composition (variants by engine group) |
|---|---|---|
| Home | `HomeQuickLinks` replaces `ExperienceFeatures` home and the house-note | The hero's identity is kept in 01–04. Then an **Opiniones strip near the top** (2 reviews with the fictional label), then a direct links grid: Menú, Reservas, Ubicación and the rest. No "Una idea sencilla / Qué te apetece / Ven con tiempo" copy. |
| Menú | `MenuCollection`, with new `columns` and `photo` options | Full width: 2 columns ≥900px, 1 column on mobile. Rows keep the leader and price, and the 8 category anchors become a sticky chip bar. 01/02 use a text-forward layout with a small thumbnail per row. 03/04/05/07/08 use photo cards for selected dishes. 06 uses a 2-column text menu with a photo band per category. |
| Reservas | New `VisitPlan` around the existing `PreviewIntent` | A 3-step planner (when, who, occasion) next to a "Tu visita" summary card and an honest "demostración, no se envía ni se confirma" notice. The step and summary arrangement differs by group (stacked, side-by-side, or overlay on a photo). No availability or payment promises. |
| Sobre el restaurante | `ContextualModule` about + photo spread | Story with 2–3 photos: an asymmetric spread for artistic engines, a pull-quote plus inset for general ones, and a vertical timeline for 06. |
| Ubicación | New `LocationPanel` | A recognizable schematic demo plan (block diagram, hours, how to arrive) clearly labelled **ficticio**. Optional validated real config is a typed prop, left empty until Codex supplies verified data. See section 3. |
| Preguntas | Existing FAQ module as accessible `<details>` | Grouped under topic headings with a jump list. Layout is a 2-column sticky index for general engines and a single column for artistic ones. |
| Noticias | `CommunitySections` journal mode | One lead story plus a river of items in 01/02/05, a staggered photo flow in 03/04/07, and a text index with thumbnails in 08. |
| Opiniones | `CommunitySections` reviews mode | Narrative proof: a large pull quote, supporting cards, and the fictional disclosure kept right below the heading so it stays findable. |
| Contacto | `CommunitySections` contact mode | A grid of clear options (correo, WhatsApp, redes as demo placeholders, plus Reservas and Menú shortcuts). |
| Plato | `DishDetail` | Photo when Codex's per-dish binding exists, otherwise the current text layout with a note. The primary CTA is **Reservar mesa**, the secondary is **Volver a {categoría}**. No "Elegir este plato". |
| Créditos | Unchanged | Extended to list the new dish photos and motion notes. |

**Navigation labels:** Menú, Reservas, Sobre el restaurante, Ubicación, Preguntas, Noticias, Opiniones, Contacto. I will use one label map consumed by nav, footer, breadcrumbs, titles and home links, so the public labels change without touching routes. The legacy `/pedidos` route stays reachable, un-advertised, with a clear "Volver a Menú / Reservas" link. Nothing in nav, home, menu, dish or footer points to it.

**Navigation structure:** 03 gets a desktop **left rail**. Below about 900px it collapses to a top bar with a disclosure menu (≥44px targets, ≥360px width). The other engines keep their own top or header nav variants.

## 3. Shared component, media and motion plan

- **Edited files:** `ExperienceNavigation`, `ExperienceComposition`, `StyleEngineSite`, `ArtisticPages`, `MenuCollection`, `DishDetail`, `CommunitySections`, `ExperienceFeatures` (home mode replaced), and the existing CSS (`artistic-plate.css`, `engine-*.css`, `catalogue.css`).
- **New files:** only `HomeQuickLinks`, `VisitPlan`, `LocationPanel`, `interior-kinds.css`, and the self-hosted font files. There is no new generator, service or per-customer file.
- **Hero video:** 01/02/03 drop the overlaid toggle. I will add one plain-JS conditional module (the B3 motion entry, which does not touch old clients or historical assets). The video plays muted, looped and inline only when `prefers-reduced-motion` is off, `saveData` is off, the tab is visible, the hero is in view, and `play()` is not rejected. In every other case it shows the poster. Pause and resume move into a navigation **"Movimiento"** utility (a real button with `aria-pressed`), outside the hero. It needs Codex's scoped motion-intent metadata to know which pages and videos it applies to.
- **Dish photos:** a helper reads Codex's per-dish media bindings and renders them through `ContextualImage` with the new handle, with an honest "imagen ilustrativa" label. Dishes without a binding keep the text layout, and I never imply a photo is that exact dish.
- **Location:** the plan is the demo schematic, with no invented coordinates or address, and "ficticio" stays visible.
  - **Optional real config:** a typed optional prop holds a validated address and coordinates from Codex's pure helper.
  - **Map loading:** Google Maps or OSM loads only when the user presses a button, with no hard-coded API key.
  - **Geolocation:** requested only after a separate explicit click.
  - **Without config:** the buttons stay absent or disabled with an explanation.
  - **Offline:** there are no runtime requests other than the explicit map.
- **Accessibility:** body text ≥14px, controls ≥44px, contrast ≥4.5:1, visible focus, and no critical content behind hover. Reduced motion disables the view transitions, reveals and the grayscale transition. Images keep native `<picture>`/`<video>`, media budgets and the existing rights gates.

## 4. Risks and questions for Codex

1. **Font supply:** I need the six faces as WOFF2 and their licences. Without them, 04–08 fall back as described above.
2. **Hero video and the poster:** this needs the scoped motion metadata. Until then I would only wire the module and leave the hero on the poster.
3. **Label map vs. contracts:** `richExperiencePages` labels may be asserted by tests or hashes. I'll override them in a presentation layer and avoid editing the contract, unless you tell me otherwise.
4. **Legacy `selection` page:** its cart script (`catalogue-client`) will no longer be advertised. Please confirm the route may keep its current page, with a return link added.
5. **Duotone and photo selection:** 07 and 08 need the 19 admitted art-stock choices mapped to slots. I'll reuse the ids already in `ArtisticPages` (for example 1665402, 1543170, 4367047 and the rest) unless Codex lists new ones.
6. **Scope:** 8 engines × 10 page kinds × new type is large. If the budget runs short, I'd do the shared components and nav labels first, then 05–08 homes, then 04 and 03.
7. **Not verified:** I haven't built or rendered anything. Codex needs to run the screenshots, the a11y/performance checks and the historical byte-exact preservation check.

I'll wait for Codex's feedback and the staged baseline, media and helpers before editing.
